 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order
The present petition has been filed under Section 439 CrPC seeking regular bail in connection with FIR No. 282/2019 under Section 363 IPC registered at Police Station Badarpur.

Subsequently,
charge-sheet has been filed under Sections 363/366/376/174A IPC, Sections 4/6 POCSO Act,
Section 84 of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 and Section 9 of The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

He submits that a copy of the nikkahnama was furnished by the victim to the I.O concerned, which was verified by the I.O and the same has been found to be genuine.
3. While appearing on 23.01.2024, the victim had stated that since she has solemnised marriage with the petitioner, therefore, she has no objection in case the petitioner is granted bail.
Accordingly, the petitioner was enlarged on interim bail for a period of one month.

Accordingly, the petitioner is enlarged on bail subject to his furnishing a Personal Bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- and one Surety Bond of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court/CMM/Duty Magistrate, further subject to the following conditions:-
a) Petitioner shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.

b) Petitioner shall provide mobile number to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and he shall not change the mobile number without prior intimation to the Investigating Officer concerned.
7. The petition stands disposed of.
8. Copy of the order be forwarded to the concerned Jail Superintendent for necessary compliance and information.
9. Order dasti under signatures of the Court Master.
10. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J FEBRUARY 16, 2024/
